identification: Framed work on paper: dense vase of flowers (pink daisies/zinnias, pink lily, red tubular/pointed flowers, yellow and blue blossoms) in heavy black outlines with flat saturated colour on a yellow-to-orange ground; medium looks like gouache/coloured ink or felt marker over black outline (possibly a hand-coloured print/stencil). Monogram 'MP' lower right in capitals; '46' (date?) upper right. Black mount, modern oak-look box frame. 40 x 28 cm. Style recalls Margaret Preston's black-outline hand-coloured woodcuts/stencils (she used an MP monogram), so the attribution question needs checking.

viewing_check: Lift or look under the mount edges for a pencil signature or title in the margin ('Margaret Preston' would change everything); check the paper (old rag paper vs modern cartridge) and whether colour is felt-tip/marker (bleeds, streaky, modern sheen) versus gouache or a hand-coloured woodcut (black lines with printed ink texture, slight embossing from the block); check the back for labels, gallery stamps, or a school name. If it is marker on cartridge paper, walk away.
